spec_match.rationale: Implements the CSS Pseudo 4 §4.4 example verbatim (content: "ⓘ" / "" under @media (any-pointer: coarse)) and the opt-in rule (UA sets no content); generation measured by geometry, not by CSS.supports.

interactive.rationale: Content radio (none / ⓘ / text) and gate radio rewrite the author rule live; readout re-measures each host; tapping the ⓘ shows interest and logs it.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises content and gate switches, live box measurement and immediate interest on tap; all delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers content:none, media-gated-off and unsupported (no box) states; deeper edges live on sibling pages.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5070829070188544 and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts box generation on button/link, no box by default, and the rest; 9/9 pass with the flag, 5/9 without on Chrome 153.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome 153 + flag desktop/mobile: link box +50px, button box +50px, tapping the button's ⓘ logged interest 'right after a click on the host' and opened #hint-btn; without the flag 0px boxes and the honest fallback note. Console clean both ways.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the geometry probe ran (with fallback flag) and that ⓘ activation showed interest only when boxes render.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables; ⓘ is ivory on black (19.7:1); readouts black on stone.

accessibility.rationale: Native radios/checkboxes/buttons with labels and ≥44px rows; readouts are role=status/log live regions. Per spec the ⓘ is not focusable and not in the accessibility tree (confirmed: Tab skips it; CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree shows no node for it); keyboard users reach the same content by focusing the host.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 (touch) or 1280×800, flag on and off; controls stack; screenshots read. Note: headless touch emulation did not make (any-pointer: coarse) match, so the coarse-gated branch was exercised only via its 'media query false' path.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the coarse-pointer branch on a real touch device
openQuestions.detail: Headless emulation never matched (any-pointer: coarse). Verify on Android Chrome with the flag that the gated ⓘ appears and that long-press on the host still offers the 'Show details' context-menu path.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment; verification used headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright with and without --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, plus Read screenshots. Repeat with DevTools MCP and inspect the accessibility tree (project rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use popover=hint targets positioned via the implicit anchor with position-area; gate inset:auto/margin:0 inside @supports (position-area: …) so browsers without anchor positioning keep centred placement; never move focus into the hint.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All hint popovers use position-area inside @supports(position-area: block-end) with position-try-fallbacks; no focus is moved on interest.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless Chrome 153 desktop+mobile: popovers open adjacent to their invoker; no horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: coarse pointer media query touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets at least 44px and adapt controls to pointer type.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The ⓘ pseudo-element and every control are ≥44px; the coarse-pointer gate follows the spec's @media (any-pointer: coarse) example.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Verification script reported no button/input under 44px tall at 360×740 and 1280×800.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo controls no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit grids with min(100%, …) tracks and wrap flex rows so nothing overflows narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control fieldsets and card grids use repeat(auto-fit|auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, Nrem), 1fr)); readouts use overflow-wrap:anywhere.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360 and 1280 for every page, flag on and off.

summary: Canonical opt-in demo verified with and without the flag; ⓘ activation shows interest immediately; CSS.supports gotcha surfaced.
